 Devansh Singh November 8, 2026 · 1 min read IM Anuj Shrivatri of Madhya Pradesh won the 7th ASEAN Plus Individual Open Chess Championship and earned the Grandmaster title. After losing the first game, Anuj scored 7/8 points to win the tournament. With this, India gained its 100th Grandmaster, and Madhya Pradesh got its first. Huge congratulations to Anuj and his family on this achievement!

 The journey was long and long-awaited by many. Indians were waiting for that 100-mark, and people in Madhya Pradesh were waiting for their first. On the auspicious day of Diwali, this is a gift from Anuj to all of us!!
 By being consistent in rapid and blitz this year, Anuj gave his best and won the 7th ASEAN Plus Individual Open Chess Championship 
 Despite losing his 1st game, he came back and managed to win the final two rounds on demand to secure the title A full report with an interview will be published soon!
